And it was your wife that did the summoning, though you knew that already, didn’t you?}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 25}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Handmaiden Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Handmaiden, also known as [[Nakothi]]’s Handmaiden, is a terrifying and highly intelligent servant of the [[Great Elder]] [[Nakothi]]. Described in classical [[Imperial]] history as nightmare-like tapestries of flesh, these creatures possess a cruel intellect and have historically functioned as overseers or managers for the [[Dead Mother]]'s harvests, selecting specific human parts for [[Nakothi]]'s use. Physically, they are massive, towering over the tallest trees and possessing pale, undulating tentacles covered in human-like hands. They move by rolling forward on these tentacles rather than walking and are capable of immense [[destruction]], such as uprooting trees to use as projectiles. A Handmaiden's presence is often accompanied by an entourage of the [[Children of Nakothi]]—monstrous, shapeless minions born from human remains infused with the Elder's power. The Handmaiden acts as a shepherdess to these creatures, directing them with her calls and shrieks. Their arrival is often a sign of [[Nakothi]]'s intent to destroy everything in her path, including the land, weapons, and people involved in a specific event. While they are far more dangerous than lesser [[Elderspawn]], they can be defeated if an Awakened weapon is used to turn their own power against them. Exposure to a Handmaiden's gaze can also drive individuals to madness.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|This massive Elder creature stands at least sixty or seventy feet tall, towering over the island's tallest trees. Its hideous form features a skeletal, mottled torso of pale skin and a sixty-foot neck topped by a head composed of eyes, mouths, waving stalks, and bone cages. The creature moves upon a bed of swarming tentacles and possesses bony, double-jointed arms.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Described as a bundle of malice and insanity, this servant of [[Nakothi]] directs the [[Children of the Dead Mother]]. Its presence is so intense that it causes [[Syphren]] to go silent.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Handmaiden is capable of manipulating the earth by pulling a dome of dirt away from an arena. Additionally, its whistle produces a sound similar to the laughter of the [[Dead Mother]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Of Sea and Shadow}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Handmaiden possesses a skeletally thin torso mottled with white, blue, and purple hues, topped by a head composed of a chaos of mouths, eyes, waving stalks, and bone cages housing pulsing organs.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref> Her whistle bears a resemblance to the laughter of the [[Dead Mother]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" /> When a [[Handmaidens of Nakothi|Handmaiden of Nakothi]] was summoned, the hideous creature appeared as a bundle of malice and insanity that rolls upon tentacles.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 25</ref> Standing head and shoulders above the island's tallest trees, this entity utilizes swarming tentacles and bony hands.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c27">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 27</ref> The Handmaiden eventually becomes a target for cannon fire from [[The Testament]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c27" />}}
